title: Ember Relay

benchmark.surface: Color Sort Puzzle product page: direct tap interaction, gradual 3-to-7 element complexity, verified solvability and recoverable undo
transferable_principles: make the first direct action readable without a tutorial wall
increase visible decision width gradually while keeping every stage deterministically solvable
